data.one_liner: MacOS implementation of the video_player plugin.
data.what_it_does: Provides a MacOS implementation for the video_player plugin. It works alongside other libraries and the base video_player package to render video on macOS.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application targeting macOS and need to play videos.
You are using the base video_player package and need macOS platform support.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than macOS.
You need active maintenance, as the package states it needs additional maintenance.
strengths: Enables video playback specifically on macOS for Flutter apps.
Compatible with other libraries like chewie.
data.setup_notes: Requires video_player as a base dependency.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the core video player package that this plugin extends for macOS.
